description.value: Squamish Valley Gas Bar is a fuel station and convenience stop operated by Nch'ḵay̓ Development Corporation, the business arm of the Squamish Nation, located on Valley Drive in Squamish. It is one of several Nation-owned enterprises under the 'Fueling Our Future' mandate. For touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor, it serves as a practical roadside stop near the Squamish River watershed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (nchkay.com project page) confirms Squamish Valley Gas Bar as an active business owned by Nch'ḵay̓ Development Corporation (Squamish Nation), listed with address 9001 Valley Dr, Squamish, BC V8B 0B5 and phone (604) 815-4601 — phone matches OSM, but postal code differs (OSM: V8B 0B3, site: V8B 0B5). The OSM tags amenity=fuel and shop=convenience confirm it is a gas station with a convenience component, but the website page itself provides no detail on specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, or grocery inventory, leaving most checklist items null.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM records V8B 0B3, but the Nch'ḵay̓ website lists V8B 0B5. Website value used for address field.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational gas bar and convenience store on the Sea-to-Sky corridor, confirmed active by its corporate parent website. Useful to touring cyclists as a fuel and supply stop.
